newsitem.title: USA: Albright's Senate confirmation clears committee.
newsitem.headline: Albright's Senate confirmation clears committee.

text.p: The Senate Foreign Relations Committee recommended on Monday that the Senate confirm Madeleine Albright as the United States' first woman secretary of state.
The committee voted 11-0 to recommend her confirmation but the vote was left open for other members to vote later.
Committee staff members said the Senate is likely to vote on Wednesday to confirm her nomination by President Bill Clinton for the job.
The committee met briefly before Clinton's inauguration to a second term and approved Albright's nomination with no debate. Albright is currently U.S. ambassador to the United Nations.
